scenario: Deny semantics are per-event facts: what a deny suppresses (the action, queued side effects, sibling handlers) is declared exactly as probed, and a control requiring stronger suppression than the event provides cannot bind there.

control.requires: deny suppresses the guarded action before any side effect

when: the control is bound to pre_tool and a deny fires alongside a sibling handler

reasons: the guarded tool call is suppressed
sibling handler effects are reported as possible, matching the declaration
the binding is valid because the control's requirement matches deny_suppresses
must_not: claim sibling suppression the probe did not demonstrate
bind a control needing pre-side-effect suppression to an event that only cancels the action afterward
treat exit-code conventions as portable across harnesses without probing
